title: ePOV: eDNA Brazilian Plant Occurrence Validator
description: ePOV builds a curated occurrence database for Brazilian plants (Angiosperms, Gymnosperms, Pteridophytes, Bryophytes) by combining Flora e Funga do Brasil, SpeciesLink and GBIF, applying multi-layer coordinate and record quality filters plus cross-source deduplication, and exposing a web interface for spatial queries.
